clues.title: Plate: fully red plates
text: Licence plates in Bhutan are almost always **red** and can easily be seen on vehicles.
NOTE: Within Asia, Bhutan is the only country that uses full red licence plates.
clues.summary: Licence plates are almost always red and easy to spot on vehicles. In Asia, no other country uses fully red plates.

clues.title: Google car: grey, no antenna
text: Coverage in Bhutan was taken by a **grey** Google car without an antenna.
NOTE: Bhutan is the only left hand driving country which has a grey Google car. Make sure to not mix it up with a white Google car, since they can look similar.
clues.summary: A grey car with no antenna. It is the only left-hand-drive country with a grey car, but don't confuse it with a similar-looking white car.

clues.title: Guardrail: stone blocks along the road
text: Bhutan commonly uses these **stone blocks** as safety barriers on winding rural roads. These blocks are very common and often one of the best ways to recognize rural Bhutan rounds.
Guardrails, on the other hand, are rare.
clues.summary: Stone blocks line winding rural roads instead of guardrails, which are rare. They are one of the best clues for rural roads here.

clues.title: Houses: tin roofs, painted wooden frames
text: The traditional Bhutanese architecture is very distinct. Most of the houses have **tin roofs** and **wooden painted frames, **which give them a unique look.
clues.summary: Traditional houses have tin roofs and painted wooden frames, giving a very distinct look.

clues.title: Language: Dzongkha script
text: **Dzongkha **is an official language in Bhutan and has **unique-looking** letters.
NOTE: On street view, these letters can only be found in Bhutan.
clues.summary: Dzongkha is an official language with unique-looking letters. On Street View these letters only appear here.

clues.title: Coverage: mountain roads, flat only in south
text: Bhutan is a **mountainous** country and most of the coverage is located on its main mountain roads.
NOTE: In the south are flat areas where you cannot see any mountains.
clues.summary: Most coverage is on main mountain roads. Flat areas with no mountains only appear in the south.

clues.title: Roadside: prayer flags
text: **Prayer flags** near the road are typically seen in Bhutan.
clues.summary: Prayer flags near the road are typical here.

clues.title: Pole: thin metal, black at the bottom
text: **Thin** **metal poles** are occasionally found in Bhutan. They are often painted black at the bottom.
clues.summary: Occasional thin metal poles, often painted black at the bottom.

clues.title: Road marker: yellow top, white bottom
text: These are the Bhutanese road markers, notice the **yellow** top and the white bottom.
NOTE: If you are on rural roads and would like to find out where you are, these markers are the best clue to narrow down the exact location.

On national highways, the road number is found on the top of the marker, but is not labelled on the map. However, it can still be used to identify the road using [this table](https://sites.google.com/site/roadnumberingsystems/home/countries/bhutan).
clues.summary: Road markers have a yellow top and white bottom. On rural roads they are the best clue to your exact location, and on highways the road number is on top.

clues.title: Sign: red or blue town signs with town name
text: These signs are frequently found in the cities of Bhutan and are often coloured **red** or **blue**.
NOTE: As seen here, they will typically have the town name you are in written on them.

images.caption: A blue town shop sign with the town name

clues.summary: Red or blue signs are common in towns and usually carry the name of the town you are in.

clues.title: Plate: yellow plate and roof on taxis
text: Taxis in Bhutan have **yellow** licence plates and **yellow** roofs.
clues.summary: Taxis have yellow plates and yellow roofs.

clues.title: Signpost: black-and-white stripes
text: Signposts in Bhutan frequently have black-and-white **stripes**.
NOTE: Within Asia, these posts are also found in Sri Lanka, India, Nepal, Malaysia and Bangladesh. Make sure to check other clues before guessing.
clues.summary: Signposts often have black and white stripes. Sri Lanka, India, Nepal, Malaysia and Bangladesh have them too, so check other clues.

clues.title: Coverage: mostly main roads and cities
text: Most of the Bhutanese street view coverage was taken on the main roads and cities.
clues.summary: Most coverage is on the main roads and in the cities.

clues.title: Road lines: two solid white edge lines
text: Two **solid white outside lines **are only seen in western Bhutan south and close to the capital **Thimphu**.
clues.summary: Two solid white lines on the outer edges only appear in the west, in the south and near the capital.

clues.title: Landscape: flat land only in the south
text: Flat landscapes like this in Bhutan can only be found in the **south**.
NOTE: The coverage in the south is **limited** to the four regions shown on the map.

images.caption: A grassy roadside with mountains in the distance and a paved road at right

clues.summary: Flat landscapes like this only exist in the south, where coverage is limited to four regions.

clues.title: Landscape: wide flat valley, no big river
text: The Phobjikha Valley, south of Nubding, is a wide and relatively flat agricultural valley. It is by far the largest open valley with no major river visible on Street View.
clues.summary: A wide, fairly flat farming valley, the largest open valley with no major river visible on Street View.

clues.title: Google car: hook on the back
text: A **hook** can be seen on the back of the car in Haa District, mainly in the town of Ha.
NOTE: The hook is sometimes just [barely visible](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sjuWHQTbSpkjC6wAA) due to the car blur.

images.caption: Circled hook on the back of the Google car

clues.summary: A hook is visible on the back of the car in one western district, mainly in one town. It may be only barely visible through the blur.

clues.title: Coverage: late sunset lighting
text: Late **sunset coverage** can be found in two places in the country; on a small rural sideroad in the east of Mongar District and in a significantly more [urban area](https://maps.app.goo.gl/wvheeJxLJYZwuHhi7) around the town of Paro in the west.
clues.summary: Late sunset coverage exists in two places: a small rural side road in the east, and a more urban area near a town in the west.

clues.title: Airport: only one in the flat south
text: Gelephu Airport is the only airport located in the **flat south **part of Bhutan, making it recognisable.
clues.summary: The only airport in the flat southern part of the country.

clues.title: Airport: in a dry northwest valley
text: The Paro International Airport is located in a **dry** northwest valley and is one of the two northern airports.
clues.summary: An airport sitting in a dry valley in the northwest, one of two northern airports.

clues.title: Airport: dry valley vs wet valley
text: While the Paro International Airport is located in a **dry** northwest valley, the Bumthang Domestic Airport is located in a **wet** northern valley.
clues.summary: One airport is in a dry northwest valley, while the other, a domestic one, is in a wet northern valley.
